title: She built for 36 years

slides.text: SHE KEPT BUILDING FOR 36 YEARS... FOR THE GHOSTS
San Jose, California. The Winchester Mystery House. About 160 rooms. Built for one woman.
Sarah Winchester. She married into the family behind the Winchester rifle, 'the gun that won the West.'
In 1866 her baby daughter died. In 1881 her husband died. She inherited a fortune.
In 1886 she bought a farmhouse in San Jose... and the construction didn't stop until she died, 36 years later.
The legend: a medium told her the spirits of people killed by Winchester rifles would come for her... unless she kept building.
Inside, there are stairs that run straight into the ceiling... and doors that open onto walls.
On the second floor, a door opens onto nothing. Just a drop to the garden below.
She died in 1922. Historians say the ghost story is mostly legend. But you can still tour it... by flashlight.
